title: spec(migrations): two step-18 upgrade rationale fragments print a tracker id to the author, "(#11509, ruling A-narrow)", in `os migrate meta` and the upgrade guide
body:
**Filing gate ①**: wrong text frozen into a release, with a named landing.
- **`reach:`** the public CLI entry. `os migrate meta --from 17` prints each step's `rationale` to the author (`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/meta.ts:933`, `hop.rationale`), and the generated upgrade guide prints the same text (`packages/spec/scripts/build-upgrade-guide.ts:114`, `step.rationale`). The text ships in the published `@objectstack/spec`. AGENTS.md's runtime-string rule says a string shown to an author carries no tracker number.

**Filed by** the `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · `huangyiirene` · session `session_01HSDGREvqxQUt7K7pjHXMyC`, as the carrier that contract review `6235567508` on PR #24170 names for this debt. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane, grade and `area:*` are triage's.

## Measured on `origin/main` `bd4276a91`

`packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template` (`STEP18_RATIONALE`) has two `text:` fragments that carry a tracker id:
- **`element-flat-data-binding-retired`**, `:1746`: "It also retires the element layer's second data door (#11509, ruling A-narrow): …".
- **`object-grid-default-filters-retired`**, `:2336`: "It also retires `object-grid`'s `defaultFilters` (#11509, ruling A-narrow, in the shape of the `defaultSort` retirement): …".

History:
- The 2026-10-04 sweep `f623e2f71` (PR #21698, stage 9 of ruling `5902360492`) removed every tracker id from this list.
- These two were authored afterwards, by `317cddd40` (PR #22421, 2026-10-10).
- They were carried into the template by `ed1de8c2d` (#22706).

PR #24170 hit the same defect in a new fragment, and its review (`6234523454`, FAIL) had it fixed before landing. These two are the remaining positions of the family. A scan of every `#` followed by digits in the template's non-comment lines at the PR #24170 head found exactly these two (record `6235567508`).

## The work

Restate each fragment's parenthetical in words, the way `f623e2f71` did for the rest of the list: "(#11509, ruling A-narrow)" becomes the decision in words, or just "(ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove)" if that is what the ruling is. Keep the id in the `//` comments beside the entries. This is comment-equivalent prose in one file; no accept set, export or conversion moves. The changeset level is the reader's to measure (the rationale is published text).

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:spec` seat, one PR on `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template` (a shared hot file, one PR at a time).

**Not proposed here:** a new gate for `text:` fields. The review notes that `check:doc-authoring` does not reach that position. Under the four-axis frame a new gate defaults to no unless the maintainer names one, so this card fixes the two strings only.
